parsed_results.text: The goal is to run the job once.
We did not retry failed payments; we retried failed notifications.
Unlike Lee et al. [4], we found no improvement in the smaller sample.
The deployment finally worked. My celebratory dance was mercifully undocumented.
The cache may reduce latency by roughly 10% for repeated requests, but we have not tested cold starts.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype is designed to detect duplicate invoices, which may help the finance team. We have not yet tested its accuracy.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope while limiting the effect of outliers.
The migration is finally complete. "Ready to launch," the manager said. We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. In our 30-minute test, median latency for repeated requests dropped from 80 ms to 60 ms. We have not yet tested cold starts or the other eight servers. While this may reduce support tickets, the dashboard currently still displays yesterday's data.
